title: Procedure Text
summary: Technical and instructional literacy: analyzing goals, materials, sequence steps, imperative syntax, troubleshooting conditionals, and ensuring procedural safety.

lessons.title: The Structural Triad: Goal, Materials/Equipment, and Method

blocks.html:
Instructional Literacy: Understanding How Things Work

A Procedure Text (or instructional text) guides readers to achieve a specific outcome through a clearly ordered, reproducible sequence of actions. Examples range from culinary recipes and scientific experiment protocols to electronic device manuals and emergency evacuation procedures.

blocks.title: Generic Structure Formula: Procedure Text
blocks.html:
\[ \text{Procedure Text} = \text{Goal / Aim (Headline)} + \text{Materials / Tools / Ingredients} + \sum_{s=1}^p \text{Step}_s (\text{Imperative Directives}) \]
KomponenFungsi / MaknaContoh Penerapan
1. Goal / AimMenyatakan tujuan akhir yang hendak dicapai (sering tercantum langsung pada judul teks).Heading: 'How to Calibrate a Digital Multimeter', 'Safe Operating Procedure'
2. Materials / EquipmentDaftar bahan baku, komponen, perangkat keras, atau perkakas yang mutlak dibutuhkan.Bullet points: Quantified list of ingredients, safety goggles, wrench sizes
3. Steps / MethodRangkaian instruksi terurut menggunakan kata kerja imperatif yang wajib dipatuhi secara bertahap.Numbered sequence: Step 1 -> Step 2 -> Step 3 with precise operational metrics

Catatan Penting: Ketiadaan satu bahan atau kesalahan urutan langkah dapat menggagalkan seluruh hasil prosedur.

blocks.title: Simulasi Interaktif: Rekonstruksi Urutan Prosedur Teknis
blocks.caption: Uji ketajaman logika Anda merangkai langkah-langkah eksperimen laboratorium yang teracak.

blocks.title: Tipe Pertanyaan TKA pada Teks Prosedur
blocks.html:
1. What must be done immediately prior to step 4? (Mencari aksi prasyarat).
  2. What is the function of adding substance X? (Menganalisis tujuan spesifik satu langkah).
  3. Who is the intended audience of this manual? (Menentukan target pembaca).

lessons.title: Imperative Syntax, Action Verbs, and Precise Adverbs of Manner

blocks.html:
Command Syntax: The Imperative Mood

Unlike descriptive or narrative texts that use declarative sentences, procedure texts employ the imperative mood. The sentence begins directly with an action verb (base form $V_1$), with the grammatical subject 'You' being understood implicitly.

blocks.title: Imperative Sentence Structure and Adverbial Quantifiers
blocks.html:
\[ \text{Command} = [V_1 \text{ (Base Action Verb)}] + [\text{Object / Target Component}] + [\text{Adverbial (Manner / Duration / Precision)}] \]
KomponenFungsi / MaknaContoh Penerapan
Base Form Action Verb (V1)Dimulai tanpa 'to' dan tanpa imbuhan (-s, -ed, -ing).Examples: 'Insert', 'Tighten', 'Dilute', 'Calibrate', 'Rotate'
Negative Imperatives (Prohibitions)Perintah larangan mutlak menggunakan kata 'Do not' atau 'Never'.Examples: 'Do not expose to open flame', 'Never touch bare wires'
Adverbs of Manner & PrecisionMenentukan cara, kecepatan, dan derajat kehati-hatian tindakan.Examples: 'Gently swirl', 'Tighten clockwise firmly', 'Apply evenly'
Adverbials of Duration / ExtentMenentukan batasan waktu atau suhu secara presisi matematis.Examples: 'Heat at 75°C for exactly 15 minutes', 'Allow to cool completely'

Catatan Penting: Jangan lewatkan adverbia cara: 'vigorously' (dengan kuat) menghasilkan reaksi yang sangat berbeda dengan 'gently' (dengan lembut).

blocks.title: Contoh Analisis Kalimat Imperatif
blocks.question: Instruction: 'Rotate the valve counterclockwise by a quarter turn; never force the mechanism if resistance is felt.' What are the key directives?
steps: Perintah Positif: 'Rotate the valve counterclockwise by a quarter turn' (Putar katup berlawanan arah jarum jam seperempat putaran).
Larangan Mutlak: 'never force the mechanism' (jangan pernah memaksakan mekanisme).
Kondisi Pengecualian: 'if resistance is felt' (jika terasa ada hambatan/tahanan).
blocks.answer: Pengguna harus memutar katup seperempat putaran berlawanan jarum jam, dan wajib segera berhenti jika terasa ada hambatan.

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: Which sentence represents a correct IMPERATIVE directive in a technical manual?

options.A: You should be tightening the screw until it clicks.
options.B: Tightening the screw is necessary for safety.
options.C: Tighten the hex screw firmly until an audible click is heard.
options.D: The technician tightened the screw clockwise.

blocks.hint: Kalimat imperatif dimulai langsung dengan Base Verb (V1).
blocks.explanation: 'Tighten the hex screw firmly until an audible click is heard' menggunakan kata kerja dasar imperatif (Tighten) dan adverbia presisi (firmly).

lessons.title: Conditionals in Instructions: If-Clauses, Precautions, and Warnings

blocks.html:
Troubleshooting Logic: Conditionals and Safety Callouts

Professional procedure texts rarely follow a single straight line. Modern manuals incorporate branching conditional statements and safety precautions to handle unexpected errors or anomalies.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting Branching Formula
blocks.html:
\[ \text{If } [S + V_1 \text{ (Observed Symptom / Anomaly)}], \quad [V_1 \text{ (Corrective Action / Recovery Step)}] \]
KomponenFungsi / MaknaContoh Penerapan
CAUTION / PRECAUTIONPeringatan bahaya ringan terhadap potensi kerusakan alat atau hilangnya data.Diction: 'Caution: Disconnect power before removing outer casing.'
WARNING / DANGERPeringatan keselamatan fatal terhadap risiko cedera fisik atau sengatan listrik.Diction: 'Danger: High voltage hazard. Wear certified rubber gloves.'
Zero Conditional TroubleshootingMenghubungkan gejala malafungsi dengan langkah korektif standar.'If the indicator flashes amber, replace the secondary fuse immediately.'

Catatan Penting: Perhatikan hierarki keselamatan: 'Danger' menyangkut keselamatan nyawa, sedangkan 'Caution' menyangkut integritas perangkat.

blocks.title: Contoh Analisis Troubleshooting
blocks.question: Manual Step: 'If the device fails to boot and emits three short beeps, inspect the RAM seating. However, if a continuous high-pitched tone is produced, immediately power off the unit to prevent thermal runaway.' What should be done when a continuous tone sounds?
steps: Kondisi 1: Gagal boot + tiga bunyi bip pendek -> periksa dudukan RAM (inspect RAM seating).
Kondisi 2: Bunyi nada tinggi terus-menerus (continuous high-pitched tone) -> segera matikan daya unit (immediately power off).
Tujuan Aksi 2: Mencegah lonjakan panas berlebih (prevent thermal runaway).
blocks.answer: Pengguna harus segera mematikan daya unit perangkat untuk mencegah lonjakan panas berlebih.

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: According to an instruction manual: 'If liquid penetrates the keyboard, do NOT attempt to turn on the laptop. Immediately invert the machine and consult an authorized service technician.' What is strictly prohibited?

options.A: Inverting the machine onto a flat surface.
options.C: Powering on the laptop after liquid exposure.

blocks.hint: Perhatikan larangan eksplisit: 'do NOT attempt to turn on the laptop'.
blocks.explanation: Instruksi secara eksplisit melarang menyalakan laptop jika terkena tumpahan cairan guna mencegah korsleting fatal.

lessons.title: Integrating Visual Diagrams, Symbols, and Flowcharts

blocks.html:
Reading Multimodal Instructions: Text Meets Icons

Modern TKA assessments evaluate multimodal literacy—the ability to correlate written instructions with visual symbols, flowcharts, safety pictograms, and exploded assembly diagrams.

blocks.title: Korelasi Simbol Universal
blocks.html:
• Flammable Symbol (Flame Icon): Jauhkan dari sumber api dan percikan panas.
  • Biohazard Symbol (Trefoil Icon): Limbah biologis infeksius; wajib menggunakan APD khusus.
  • Recycling Arrow Triad (Möbius Strip): Komponen dapat didaur ulang setelah masa pakai habis.
  • Crossed-Out Wheelie Bin: Jangan buang ke tempat sampah domestik umum; bawa ke depo limbah elektronik.

blocks.title: Contoh Soal Sintesis Diagram-Teks
blocks.question: A laboratory manual states: 'Pour 50 mL of hydrochloric acid into the beaker.' Beside the text is an icon showing an acid droplet burning a hand and a metal surface, labeled with a skull. What precautionary measure is implied?
steps: Analisis Simbol: Simbol cairan menetes membakar tangan dan logam menandakan zat sangat korosif (corrosive hazard).
Simbol Tengkorak: Menandakan racun mematikan (acute toxicity).
Sintesis Multimodal: Praktikan wajib mengenakan sarung tangan tahan asam (acid-resistant gloves) dan pelindung mata sebelum menuang asam.
blocks.answer: Tindakan pencegahan mutlak adalah memakai sarung tangan pelindung tahan asam dan kacamata pengaman karena zat bersifat korosif dan berbahaya.

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: In an electronic assembly guide, a diagram illustrates a bolt circled with a curved clockwise arrow labeled '15 Nm'. What does this indicate to the assembler?

options.A: Loosen the bolt by turning it counterclockwise.
options.B: Tighten the bolt clockwise with a torque rating of 15 Newton-meters.
options.C: Discard the bolt after 15 days of continuous operation.
options.D: Drill a 15-millimeter hole through the metal plate.

blocks.hint: Panah searah jarum jam (clockwise) dan satuan Nm (Newton-meter) adalah spesifikasi torsi pengencangan baut.
blocks.explanation: Panah searah jarum jam dengan satuan 15 Nm berarti mengencangkan baut ke arah kanan dengan batas torsi 15 Newton-meter.

lessons.title: Evaluating Procedural Efficiency, Omissions, and Target Audience

blocks.html:
Critical Evaluation: Spotting Ambiguity and Missing Steps

Evaluative TKA questions test whether you can identify logical gaps in instructions: 'What essential step did the author omit before step 5?' or 'Why is instruction B ambiguous?'

blocks.title: Kriteria Kejelasan Prosedur yang Baik
blocks.html:
1. Completeness: Setiap alat yang dibutuhkan pada langkah eksekusi harus tercantum di daftar bahan/alat di awal.
  2. Precision: Menghindari instruksi ambigu seperti 'tambahkan sedikit garam' dalam resep sains; harus menggunakan takaran kuantitatif eksak (misal: 'add 2.5 grams').
  3. Safety Warnings Placed First: Peringatan bahaya wajib diletakkan SEBELUM tindakan berisiko dilakukan, bukan setelahnya.

blocks.title: Contoh Analisis Langkah yang Hilang (Omission)
blocks.question:
Step 1: 'Clean the circuit board with alcohol.'
Step 2: 'Solder the replacement capacitor onto pads A and B.'
Step 3: 'Power on the device to test functionality.'
What crucial step is missing between Step 1 and Step 2?
steps: Analisis: Alkohol adalah cairan kimia yang mudah terbakar dan menghantarkan listrik saat masih basah.
Tindakan menyolder (soldering) menghasilkan panas sangat tinggi di atas 300°C.
Langkah krusial yang terlewat: Menunggu papan sirkuit kering sempurna dari sisa cairan alkohol sebelum menyolder agar tidak memicu kebakaran atau korsleting.
blocks.answer: Langkah yang terlewat adalah membiarkan papan sirkuit mengering sepenuhnya sebelum mengaplikasikan solder panas.

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: Why is the instruction 'Heat the chemical solution until it gets hot' considered POOR technical writing?

options.B: It lacks an exact measurable temperature threshold, making it ambiguous and dangerous.
options.D: It fails to specify the color of the safety goggles.

blocks.hint: Frasa 'until it gets hot' sangat ambigu dan tidak terukur secara saintifik.
blocks.explanation: Instruksi tersebut buruk karena tidak menyertakan batas temperatur kuantitatif yang terukur secara presisi, menimbulkan risiko kecelakaan laboratorium.

lessons.title: Jebakan Urutan Operasi Bersamaan vs Berurutan

blocks.html:
Sequential vs Simultaneous Execution Traps

In procedural reading tests, questions frequently interrogate the exact chronological relationship between paired actions. Test takers often confuse actions performed sequentially (one after another) with actions performed simultaneously (at the exact same time).

blocks.title: Pembeda Kata Kunci Urutan Prosedur
blocks.html:
• Sequential (Berurutan): 'Once the mixture has cooled, add the enzyme.' (Enzim baru boleh dimasukkan SETELAH campuran dingin).
  • Simultaneous (Bersamaan): 'While continuously stirring the flask, slowly inject the reagent.' (Pengadukan dan injeksi reagen wajib dilakukan PADA SAAT BERSAMAAN).

blocks.title: Contoh Identifikasi Tindakan Simultan
blocks.question: Step: 'While monitoring the pressure gauge, slowly depress the relief lever until the needle enters the green zone.' Are these actions sequential or simultaneous?
steps: Konjungsi 'While' di awal kalimat menandakan keserentakan (simultaneity).
Dua tindakan yang berjalan bersamaan: (1) Mengawasi jarum indikator tekanan (monitoring gauge) dan (2) Menekan tuas pelepas secara perlahan (depressing lever).
Kondisi berhenti: saat jarum memasuki zona hijau.
blocks.answer: Kedua tindakan wajib dilakukan secara simultan (bersamaan).

blocks.title: Cek Pemahaman
blocks.question: Read the instruction: 'Add the yeast only after the boiled water has cooled to room temperature.' What happens if yeast is added immediately after boiling?

options.A: The fermentation will proceed at twice the normal velocity.
options.B: The extreme heat will kill the living yeast microorganisms, failing the recipe.
options.C: The mixture will turn into an insoluble solid crystal.
options.D: The container will immediately implode from vacuum pressure.

blocks.hint: Ragi adalah mikroorganisme hidup yang mati jika terkena air mendidih.
blocks.explanation: Suhu air mendidih akan mematikan mikroorganisme ragi, sehingga proses fermentasi gagal total jika instruksi pendinginan dilanggar.

lessons.title: Procedural Reading Assessment and Chapter Quiz

blocks.html:
Mastery Review: Procedure Text

Test your competence across device manuals, culinary recipes, laboratory experiments, and safety protocols in this chapter quiz:

  1. Pay close attention to restrictive conditions ('only after', 'prior to', 'while').
  2. Look out for safety warnings and troubleshooting decision trees.
  3. Differentiate prerequisite steps from final clean-up actions.

blocks.title: Instruksi Pengerjaan
blocks.html: Kuis terdiri atas 20 butir soal terstandar berbasis teks instruksional autentik.

blocks.title: Cheat Sheet: Procedural Texts, Manuals & Imperatives
blocks.subtitle: Summary of goal/aim, materials/tools, action verbs, imperative sentence syntax, and sequential transitions.
blocks.html:
1. Structural Components

  • Goal / Aim: Stated in the title or introductory objective statement (e.g., "How to Calibrate a Spectrophotometer").
  • Materials / Ingredients / Tools: The required apparatus or components listed with quantities.
  • Steps / Methods: Step-by-step instructions presented sequentially.

2. Grammatical Signposts

  • Imperative Sentences: Sentences start with bare action verbs: "Insert the probe...", "Ensure that the valve is closed...", "Do not expose...".
  • Sequencing Signals: First and foremost, next, proceed to, simultaneously, ensure that, finally.
